pilot_status: The preceding 60-question experiment is exploratory and is not included in the confirmatory statistical test.

model_settings.temperature: SDK/provider default; must not be changed between runs
model_settings.prompt: Answer the supplied multiple-choice question. Return exactly one option label: A, B, C, or D. Return no explanation, punctuation, or additional text.

execution_conditions.record_order: Preserve the JSONL order in every run.
execution_conditions.parser_policy: Use the frozen parser implemented before confirmatory execution. Do not modify it between runs.

primary_hypothesis.null: Semantic disagreement between the original and permuted runs equals semantic disagreement between the original and unchanged-repeat runs.
primary_hypothesis.alternative: Option permutation produces greater semantic disagreement than an unchanged repeat.
primary_hypothesis.primary_test: Exact two-sided McNemar test over the paired question-level disagreement indicators.

cluster_aware_analysis.method: Bootstrap the 30 tasks with replacement, retaining all 10 questions in each sampled task.
cluster_aware_analysis.reported_interval: Percentile 95% confidence interval for the excess disagreement effect.

missing_data_policy.model_call_failure: Retain and report the failed record. Do not silently rerun individual items.
missing_data_policy.unparsed_output: Count as uncovered and exclude from accuracy-on-parsed, while reporting coverage separately.
missing_data_policy.whole_run_interruption: Resume only from records not already written to predictions.jsonl. Do not repeat completed questions.
